The fix makes the dynamic codegen hoist base-class evaluation before the class body, compute an enum context from the bases (`Enum`/`Flag`/`StrEnum`), and route every class-body name store through a new `enum_auto_store` runtime helper: it keeps the assigned member values in order, converts `auto()` with the same rules as `enum_setup` (1,2,3... / powers of two / lowercased name), and memoizes the result on the auto instance as CPython does. `enum_setup`'s auto rules were refactored onto the same shared `auto_next` function. Added `tests/lib/review_l07_flag_auto_or.py` (with matching `.expected`) covering the reported case plus nearby Flag/IntFlag/Enum/StrEnum/explicit-value/shared-auto cases, and `changelog.d/review-l07.md`.
